# Verify using modulo-based digit extraction (mathematical method)
# instead of string conversion

n = 82 ** 9

# Extract digits one by one using modulo and integer division
digit_sum = 0
while n > 0:
    digit_sum += n % 10  # Extract rightmost digit
    n //= 10             # Remove rightmost digit

print(f"ANSWER: {digit_sum}")
